statement.name: vote-get_first
statement.description: Get first poll, used for development

statements.statement: SELECT hex(PollK) AS PollK FROM TPoll LIMIT 1
SELECT hex(PollK) id, FName name, FHeader header FROM TPoll {?? exists( args::exists( args, "name" ), "WHERE FName LIKE ''%{=name}%'' OR FHeader LIKE ''%{=name}%''" ) ??} ORDER BY FName
SELECT PollK, FName, FHeader, FDescription FROM TPoll WHERE PollK = {PollK}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS uCount FROM TPoll WHERE PollK = {PollK}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS uCount FROM TPollQuestion WHERE PollK = {PollK}
SELECT hex(PollK) AS PollK, TypeC, StateC, FName, FHeader, FDescription FROM TPoll WHERE PollK = {PollK}
SELECT hex(PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, FName, FLabel, FDescription FROM TPollQuestion WHERE PollK = {PollK}
SELECT hex(PollAnswerK) AS PollAnswerK, hex(PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, FName, FLabel, FDescription FROM TPollAnswer WHERE PollK = {PollK}

SELECT hex(TPoll.PollK) AS PollK, hex(TPollQuestion.PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, hex(TPollAnswer.PollAnswerK) AS PollAnswerK, TPollQuestion.FName AS Q_FName, TPollQuestion.FLabel AS Q_FLabel, TPollQuestion.FDescription AS Q_FDescription, TPollQuestion.FOrder AS Q_FOrder, TPollAnswer.FName AS A_FName, TPollAnswer.FAnswer AS A_FAnswer, TPollAnswer.FOrder AS A_FOrder, TPollAnswer.FDescription AS A_Description FROM TPoll LEFT JOIN TPollQuestion ON TPoll.PollK = TPollQuestion.PollK LEFT JOIN TPollAnswer ON TPollQuestion.PollQuestionK = TPollAnswer.PollQuestionK WHERE TPoll.PollK = {PollK} ORDER BY 1,TPollQuestion.FOrder, 2,TPollAnswer.FOrder

SELECT hex(UserK) id, FAlias alias, FFirstName name, FLastName lastname FROM TUser {?? exists( args::exists( args, "name" ), "WHERE FAlias LIKE ''%{=name}%'' OR FFirstName LIKE ''%{=name}%'' OR FLastName LIKE ''%{=name}%''" ) ??} ORDER BY FAlias
SELECT FAlias, FFirstName, FLastName, FMail, FPassword, FDisplayName, FLoginName FROM TUser WHERE UserK = x{UserK}

statement.name: cast-check_if_voted
statement.description: Check if user has already voted in poll
statement.code:
-- #lua v1; local sIp = request:GetIpAddress() -- Get user IP address local sValueIp = request:GetClientValue("Ip")
-- Check if ip matches if sValueIp ~= sIp then request:GetResponse():Message({text = "Ip mismatch", abort = true}, "error") request:SetStatus( "abort" ) return end
request:RemoveClientValue("Ip") -- Remove ip from client values, we don't need it anymore
local expression = Expression:new(); local sBinaryIp = expression:Calculate( [[str::ip_format(ip, "hex", 32 )]], { ip = sIp } ) -- Convert IP address to binary request:AddClientValue("FIp", sBinaryIp)
statement.statement: SELECT COUNT(*) as count_vote FROM TPollTie WHERE PollK = {PollK} AND FIp = {FIp}

statements.statement: { "table": "PollK;FName,Name;FHeader,Header;FDescription,Description" } SELECT hex(PollK) AS PollK, FName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TPollTie WHERE PollK = {PollK}) AS VoteCount, FHeader, FDescription FROM TPoll WHERE PollK = {PollK}

{ "table": "PollQuestionK;FLabel;FName,Name;FQuestion,Question;FQuestionMore,More;FDescription,Description" } SELECT hex(PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, FLabel, FName, FQuestion, FQuestionMore, FDescription FROM TPollQuestion WHERE PollK = {PollK} ORDER BY FOrder
SELECT hex(PollAnswerK) AS PollAnswerK, hex(PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, FName, FAnswer FROM TPollAnswer WHERE PollK = {PollK}

statement.name: cast-add_vote
statement.code:
-- #lua v1; -- ## Check if voter can vote function CanVote(sBinaryIp, sPollK) local sqlCheck = doc:CreateSql() sqlCheck:AddColumn({name = "PollTieK", alias = "count_vote", raw = "COUNT(*)"}) sqlCheck:AddCondition({name = "FIp", value = sBinaryIp, type = "binary"}) sqlCheck:AddCondition({name = "PollK", value = sPollK, type = "binary"}) local sSelectCheck = sqlCheck:AsSelect({ table = "TPollTie" }); local database = request:GetDatabase() local iVoteCount = tonumber( database:Ask(sSelectCheck) ) if iVoteCount > 0 then return false end return true end
local expression = Expression:new(); local sIp = request:GetIpAddress() -- Get user IP address local sBinaryIp = expression:Calculate( [[str::ip_format(ip, "hex", 32 )]], { ip = sIp } ) -- Convert IP address to binary local sPollK = request:GetClientValue("PollK") -- print("GetClientValue PollK: " .. sPollK)
local bCanVote = CanVote(sBinaryIp, sPollK) -- Check if user can vote bCanVote = true -- @TODO Remove after testing, allows voting multiple times from same IP if bCanVote then -- ## Insert vote into TPollTie to tie votes together local database = request:GetDatabase() local sql = doc:CreateSql() sql:AddColumn({name = "PollK", value = sPollK, type = "binary"}) sql:AddColumn({name = "FIp", value = sBinaryIp, type = "binary"}) local sInsert = sql:AsInsert({ table = "TPollTie", returning = "PollTieK" }) local sKey = database:ExecuteReturn(sInsert); request:SetScriptValue("TPollVote.FTie", sKey) return end
request:GetResponse():Message({text = "Ip has voted", abort = true}, "error") request:SetStatus( "abort" )

statement.name: cast-poll_count_total
statement.description: Count total votes for a poll

statements.statement: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_total_votes FROM TPollVote WHERE PollK = {PollK}

SELECT hex(PollAnswerK) AS PollAnswerK, hex(PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, FName, FAnswer, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TPollVote WHERE TPollVote.PollAnswerK = TPollAnswer.PollAnswerK) AS VoteCount FROM TPollAnswer WHERE PollK = {PollK}

statement.name: cast-poll_votes
statement.description: Count number of votes per answer

statements.statement: SELECT hex(TPollVote.PollAnswerK) AS PollAnswerK, COUNT(*) AS count FROM TPollVote JOIN TPollAnswer ON TPollAnswer.PollAnswerK = TPollVote.PollAnswerK WHERE TPollAnswer.PollK = {PollK} GROUP BY TPollVote.PollAnswerK

SELECT hex(TPoll.PollK) AS PollK, TPoll.FName, TPoll.FHeader, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TPollVote.FTie) FROM TPollVote JOIN TPollAnswer ON TPollAnswer.PollAnswerK = TPollVote.PollAnswerK JOIN TPollQuestion ON TPollQuestion.PollQuestionK = TPollAnswer.PollQuestionK WHERE TPollQuestion.PollK = TPoll.PollK) AS TotalVotes FROM TPoll
